sources.title: Original treaty and exchange instruments for the 1867 cession of Russian possessions in North America
sources.institution: Library of Congress / United States National Archives and Records Administration
sources.coverage: Original Treaty of Cession, imperial ratification and Certificate of Exchange for Alaska, 1867
sources.notes: Library of Congress digital presentation of the original bilingual treaty and related ratification/exchange instruments; the Certificate of Exchange is dated 20 June 1867.

sources.title: Treaty concerning the Cession of the Russian Possessions in North America — Foreign Relations of the United States
sources.institution: United States Department of State, Office of the Historian
sources.coverage: Official U.S. publication of the 1867 Alaska cession treaty text and its legal boundary description
sources.notes: Article I makes the cession effective immediately upon exchange of ratifications; Article IV states that cession and the right of immediate possession are complete and absolute at that exchange without waiting for formal delivery.
